newsitem.title: USA: Dow Corning faced with rival reorganization plan.
newsitem.headline: Dow Corning faced with rival reorganization plan.

text.p: Women with claims relating to their silicone breast implants are among Dow Corning Corp's creditors who could wind up owning as much as 95 percent of the company's common stock under a creditor bankruptcy court reorganization proposal, The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.

The proposal, being drawn up by commercial creditors and and representatives of women with breast implants, would compete with a $3 billion reorganization plan proposed by Dow Corning earlier this month, the story says.
The rival proposal could be submitted in outline to court officials as early as Thursday, the story says.
